enchantments.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus: +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Reptilian Bane 2: This weapon is attuned specifically to hunt those with cunning and scales, dealing an additional 2d10 bane damage vs. Reptilians.

Unholy 2: This weapon is used by the wicked to smite the pure, dealing an additional 2d6 evil damage on each hit. This effect makes the weapon evil aligned. Good characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
